title: Working at Height Permit
name: Working at Height Permit
description: Work-at-height permit using the avoid, prevent and minimise hierarchy with equipment, falling-object and rescue controls.

sections.title: HIERARCHY AND PLANNING
items: Work at height has been avoided where reasonably practicable
Collective fall prevention is considered before personal protection
Fall distance and consequences are minimised where prevention is not possible
Work is planned and supervised by competent people
Safe access and egress are planned
Fragile surfaces and openings are identified
Overhead hazards are assessed
Weather and lighting limits are understood

fields.label: Why Work at Height Cannot Be Avoided / Hierarchy Selection

sections.title: FALL PREVENTION AND EQUIPMENT
items: Access equipment is suitable and stable
Collective edge protection is provided where required
Scaffold / MEWP inspection records are current
Ladder use is justified and controlled where applicable
MEWP operators are competent where applicable
Work restraint is preferred to fall arrest where practicable
Anchors and lifelines are suitable and in date

fields.label: Access Equipment ID / Scaffold Tag / MEWP Number
Fall Protection System
options: No personal fall protection required - collective controls adequate

sections.title: FALLING OBJECTS AND EXCLUSION
items: Tools and materials are secured where practicable
Toe boards / debris protection are provided where required
Exclusion zone is established below the work
People and traffic are protected from overhead work
Materials are stored against rolling, sliding or wind displacement

fields.label: Tool / Material Tethering and Falling-Object Controls

sections.title: COMPETENCE AND RESCUE
items: Workers are competent for selected equipment
Required PPE has been checked
A rescue plan covers foreseeable falls or incapacitation
Rescue does not rely solely on emergency services
Rescue equipment and trained rescuers are available
Suspension intolerance is considered for fall arrest
Emergency communication is briefed

sections.title: AUTHORIZATION AND CLOSE-OUT
items: Permit issuer has verified controls
Workers and tools are removed safely
Temporary openings and edges are made safe
Access equipment is removed or secured
Exclusion zones remain until overhead hazards are eliminated
Area is inspected and safe for hand-back
